name: Sougetsu Miko Kitan
source:
Shrine maiden protects gates to another world. But as she goes to the settlement of monsters, she is lured in the trap set by tentacle beast.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-december-2004-to-heart-2.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
守护异世界之门的巫女。但当她前往怪物聚居地时，却被触手兽设下的陷阱所引诱。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-december-2004-to-heart-2.html]vndbreview[/url]]
